name: Undergrove

categories.label: Seedlings & Trees (Roots)
categories.hint: Enter points per Seedling/Tree: 1 C scores 1 Root, 2 C scores 2 Roots, a Tree scores all its Roots; each Root = value on its Mushroom tile.

categories.label: Goal cards (3 cards)
categories.hint: Score each of the 3 Goal cards per its Score table (tracks, multiplier or rank award); enter one value per card.

categories.label: Bonus tiles
categories.hint: Total points on Bonus tiles collected from the Carbon Track.

categories.label: Unused resources on player board
categories.hint: Count all unused resources; 1 point per 2 (rounded down).

categories.label: Carbon Track 2-point token
categories.hint: Tick if you claimed the token at the end of the Carbon Track.

categories.label: C on Seedlings (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: C trên Cây con (phân định hòa)

notes: family: tableau-goal-cards. Game end: when a player passes the last Carbon Track stone, finish the round then everyone gets one extra turn. Goal cards use one of three Score tables (track values, rank award by most/fewest with ties split rounded down, or multiplier); scorer enters each card's result. Some Mushroom Roots have variable values per tile text. Solo/AI mode uses different tallies and is not modelled. The 4 Trees limit: if all Trees are used, Seedlings with 3-4 C score 1 Root per C.

sources.title: Undergrove Base Game rulebook (AEG)
sources.section: p.14 Game End (scoring, winning, tiebreakers, scorepad); p.13 Goal cards score tables
